indicators.label: Real GDP growth
indicators.plain_language: How fast the economy's total output grew last quarter, at an annual rate, adjusted for inflation.

source.title: Real Gross Domestic Product
source.transformation: BEA headline growth rate, cross-checked against the compounded annual rate computed from GDPC1 levels

indicators.label: Unemployment rate
indicators.plain_language: The share of the labor force that is not working and is looking for work.

indicators.label: CPI inflation
indicators.plain_language: Consumer prices vs. one year ago, measured by the Consumer Price Index — the inflation number in the news.

source.title: Consumer Price Index for All Urban Consumers: All Items in U.S. City Average
source.transformation: 12-month percent change computed from index levels, cross-checked against FRED's pc1 transformation

indicators.label: PCE inflation
indicators.plain_language: Consumer prices vs. one year ago, measured by the PCE price index — the Fed's preferred gauge.

source.title: Personal Consumption Expenditures: Chain-type Price Index
source.transformation: 12-month percent change computed from index levels, cross-checked against FRED's pc1 transformation

indicators.label: Federal funds rate
indicators.plain_language: The interest rate banks charge each other overnight — the Fed's main policy lever.

source.title: Federal Funds Effective Rate
source.transformation: latest daily effective rate; the trend line shows the monthly average (FEDFUNDS, last updated 2026-08-03 15:16:35-05)
